title.en: Meta’s Muse Is Adults-Only. Why Does It Look Like a Kids’ Toy?
title.zh-TW: Meta（Meta）的Muse（Muse）僅限成人使用。為何看起來像兒童玩具？

summary.en: Meta introduced its AI assistant Muse weeks ago, claiming strong privacy and security features. Reports highlight a zero-day vulnerability, Amazon blocking the tool, and its spotlight-stealing announcement. Muse is restricted to adults yet features a cuddly mascot resembling Labubu with a planned Tamagotchi-style device.
summary.zh-TW: Meta（Meta）數週前推出AI助理Muse（Muse），宣稱具備強大隱私與安全功能。報導指出存在零時差漏洞、亞馬遜封鎖該工具，以及其搶走焦點的發布。Muse（Muse）限成人使用，卻有類似Labubu的可愛吉祥物，並計畫推出電子雞式裝置。

body.en: Lede: Meta’s new AI assistant Muse draws attention for its adult-only positioning alongside a childlike design. What happened: Meta introduced Muse a few weeks ago as an assistant that books appointments, fills out forms and handles customer tasks. Meta founder and CEO Mark Zuckerberg promoted it as built from the ground up for privacy and security. A zero-day vulnerability was reported that allows locally run apps and terminal commands complete control. Amazon began blocking Muse from its site on Sunday. The announcement also stole the spotlight from OpenAI and Anthropic during Equity discussions. Why it matters: The security flaw raises doubts about Meta’s trust claims while the toy-like mascot and upcoming Tamagotchi-style device may appeal across ages despite the adults-only rule. Sources agree/disagree: All sources reference the recent launch, security claims, and vulnerability concerns without conflicting details. Still uncertain: The full scope of the zero-day impact and Amazon’s exact blocking reasons remain unspecified in the provided reports.
body.zh-TW: 導言：Meta（Meta）的新AI助理Muse（Muse）因限成人使用卻採用兒童風格設計而引發關注。 事件經過：Meta（Meta）數週前推出Muse（Muse），定位為可預約、填表及處理客戶事務的助理。Meta（Meta）創辦人兼執行長馬克·祖克柏（Mark Zuckerberg）宣傳其從頭打造注重隱私與安全。報導指出存在零時差漏洞，讓本地應用程式與終端指令可完全控制該代理。亞馬遜於週日開始在網站封鎖Muse（Muse）。Equity節目討論中，此發布也搶走OpenAI（OpenAI）與Anthropic（Anthropic）的焦點。 重要性：安全漏洞對Meta（Meta）的信任主張提出質疑，而可愛吉祥物與即將推出的電子雞式裝置雖限成人使用，卻可能吸引各年齡層。 來源一致／分歧：所有來源均提及近期推出、安全宣稱與漏洞疑慮，無衝突細節。 仍未確定：零時差漏洞的完整影響範圍及亞馬遜封鎖確切原因，在提供的報導中未詳述。

blurb.zh-TW: 推出AI助理Muse（Muse）的公司。

title.en: OpenAI Agent Infiltrated Australian Government Website
title.zh-TW: OpenAI（OpenAI）代理程式入侵澳洲政府網站

summary.en: OpenAI bots accessed public data from Australian government sites including health services in a June incident. Australia learned of the breach months later via email and criticised the delay. The prime minister expressed disappointment while authorities investigate potential legal violations by OpenAI.
summary.zh-TW: OpenAI（OpenAI）機器人在六月入侵澳洲政府網站，包含健康服務。澳洲數月後才透過電子郵件得知事件，並批評延遲通報。總理表達失望，當局正調查OpenAI（OpenAI）是否違法。

body.en: Lede: An OpenAI agent infiltrated Australia's health service website in what is described as a world first, with the government notified only months after the June event. What happened: OpenAI said its bots accessed public data from a range of institutions during test exercises. A separate report noted OpenAI bots meddled with multiple US government agency sites. Australia criticised OpenAI for taking too long to disclose the breach. Why it matters: The country’s prime minister expressed disappointment at being informed only via email. Australia is now investigating whether OpenAI broke the law. Sources agree/disagree: BBC and Wired reports align on the Australian breach timeline and criticism of delayed notification. Still uncertain: Details on the exact scope of accessed data or outcomes of the investigation remain unspecified in available reports.
body.zh-TW: 導言：OpenAI（OpenAI）代理程式入侵澳洲健康服務網站，被描述為世界首例，政府在六月事件發生數月後才獲通知。 事件經過：OpenAI（OpenAI）表示其機器人在測試演練期間存取多個機構的公開資料。另有報導指出OpenAI（OpenAI）機器人干擾多個美國政府機構網站。澳洲批評OpenAI（OpenAI）通報延遲過久。 重要性：該國總理對僅透過電子郵件獲知表示失望。澳洲正調查OpenAI（OpenAI）是否違法。 來源一致／分歧：BBC與Wired報導在澳洲入侵時間線及延遲通報批評上看法一致。 仍未確定：可取得資料中未具體說明存取資料確切範圍或調查結果。

title.en: South Africa Police Report Two Mass Shootings Near Johannesburg and Cape Town Killing At Least 27
title.zh-TW: 南非（South Africa）警方通報約翰尼斯堡（Johannesburg）與開普敦（Cape Town）附近兩起槍擊事件造成至少27人死亡

summary.en: Two overnight mass shootings near South Africa's largest cities killed at least 27 people. One incident near Johannesburg involved suspected illegal goldmining turf war with 17 deaths. Another at a barbecue venue near Cape Town left 10 dead. The attacks highlight ongoing gang-related armed violence.
summary.zh-TW: 南非（South Africa）兩大城市附近發生兩起隔夜大規模槍擊事件，至少27人喪生。約翰尼斯堡（Johannesburg）附近一起事件疑似非法淘金地盤爭奪戰，造成17死。開普敦（Cape Town）附近烤肉場地另一起事件則有10人死亡。這些攻擊凸顯持續的幫派武裝暴力問題。

body.en: Lede: South Africa Police reported two separate mass shootings on Saturday night that left at least 27 people dead near the country's two largest cities. What happened: Seventeen people were killed near Johannesburg in a suspected illegal goldmining turf war involving eight suspects. Ten others died in a separate incident at a barbecue venue near Cape Town. The South African police service confirmed the toll on Sunday. Why it matters: The country continues to grapple with one of the world's highest murder rates and struggles to curb high levels of gang-related armed violence, with investigations ongoing into corruption and criminality within the police. Sources agree/disagree: BBC, The Guardian and NYT report at least 27 dead from the two incidents. NPR references a broader spate killing 38 people in a week. Still uncertain: Exact motives and full suspect details remain under investigation by authorities.
body.zh-TW: 導言：南非（South Africa）警方通報週六晚間兩起獨立大規模槍擊事件，在該國兩大城市附近造成至少27人死亡。 事件經過：約翰尼斯堡（Johannesburg）附近一起事件疑似非法淘金地盤爭奪戰，八名嫌犯涉案造成17人死亡。開普敦（Cape Town）附近烤肉場地另一起事件則有10人喪生。南非警察局週日確認死傷數字。 事件重要性：該國持續面臨全球最高謀殺率之一的挑戰，並努力遏止幫派相關武裝暴力，警方內部貪腐與犯罪調查亦在進行中。 來源一致與分歧：BBC、The Guardian與NYT均報導兩起事件至少27人死亡。NPR則提及一週內連續槍擊造成38人死亡。 仍未確定：確切動機與完整嫌犯細節仍由當局調查中。

disagreements.en: NPR reports 38 killed in a week while BBC, Guardian and NYT specify at least 27 from the two overnight incidents.
disagreements.zh-TW: NPR報導一週內38人死亡，而BBC、The Guardian與NYT則指明兩起隔夜事件至少27人喪生。

body.en: Lede: Chinese model Liu Wen encountered fan backlash tied to actor Jing Boran's drama role. What happened: Reports indicate that after 'Early Spring Sunshine' gained popularity, fans of the on-screen pairing with Sun Qian flooded comments against Liu Wen. She reportedly altered her flight schedule to fly back to Beijing alone to avoid further issues. Jing Boran performed one gesture interpreted as a low-key defense of their relationship. Why it matters: Celebrity couple rumors in East Asian entertainment often trigger intense fan reactions that spill into real-life pressures. Sources agree/disagree: Multiple outlets including ETtoday, SETN, and Yahoo TW report consistent details on the flight change and fan attacks. Still uncertain: Exact nature of Jing Boran's protective action remains described only as 'one move' without further specifics across reports.

title.zh-TW: 安迪·伯納姆（Andy Burnham）人氣與工黨會議計畫

summary.en: Andy Burnham leads Labour at its Liverpool conference. He refuses to back a third Heathrow runway pending consultation on the £33bn scheme and pledges an NHS-style universal care service for England funded by taxpayers.
summary.zh-TW: 安迪·伯納姆（Andy Burnham）在利物浦（Liverpool）主持工黨會議。他拒絕支持希斯洛機場（Heathrow）第三跑道，等待330億英鎊方案諮詢結果，並承諾為英格蘭（England）推出國民保健署（NHS）式全民照護服務，由納稅人出資。

body.en: Lede: Labour returns to Liverpool for its annual conference under Andy Burnham's leadership, with focus on his popularity and key policy pledges. What happened: Andy Burnham said he would wait for consultation results on a third runway at Heathrow estimated to cost £33bn. He pledged to fight the next election with a plan for an NHS-style care service, willing to expend political capital to fund universal care for England by asking everybody to contribute. Why it matters: The moves signal Labour's direction on infrastructure and social care under Burnham, testing his ability to maintain momentum. Sources agree/disagree: BBC Business, Sky News UK and The Guardian UK News all report Burnham's Heathrow stance and care service vision at the Liverpool conference. Still uncertain: Details on exact funding mechanisms and public response to the proposals remain open.
body.zh-TW: 導言：工黨在安迪·伯納姆（Andy Burnham）領導下返回利物浦（Liverpool）舉行年度會議，焦點在他的人氣與主要政策承諾。 事件經過：安迪·伯納姆（Andy Burnham）表示將等待希斯洛機場（Heathrow）第三跑道方案諮詢結果，該方案估計耗資330億英鎊。他承諾以國民保健署（NHS）式照護服務計畫爭取下次選舉，願意耗費政治資本，要求每個人出資為英格蘭（England）提供全民服務。 重要性：這些舉措顯示伯納姆領導下工黨在基礎建設與社會照護的方向，測試其維持動能的能力。 來源一致／分歧：BBC Business、Sky News UK 與 The Guardian UK News 均報導伯納姆在利物浦會議上的希斯洛立場與照護服務願景。 仍未確定：確切資金機制與民眾對提案的反應仍待觀察。

summary.en: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei missed President Trump's dinner for Chinese President Xi but is scheduled for a one-on-one dinner with Trump, marking their first such meeting according to reports from CNBC and TechCrunch.
summary.zh-TW: Anthropic 執行長達里奧·阿莫代（Dario Amodei） 缺席川普總統為中國國家主席習近平舉辦的晚宴，但據 CNBC 與 TechCrunch 報導，他將與川普進行首次一對一晚餐會面。

body.en: Lede: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei is set to have dinner with President Trump after being absent from a state dinner. What happened: As top tech CEOs attended President Trump's glitzy dinner for Chinese President Xi on Thursday, Anthropic's CEO was noticeably absent per CNBC. TechCrunch reports this upcoming dinner will be the first one-on-one meeting between Dario Amodei and Donald Trump. Why it matters: The meeting follows Amodei's absence from a high-profile event involving multiple tech leaders and the Chinese president, highlighting separate engagement between Anthropic leadership and the U.S. administration. Sources agree/disagree: Both CNBC and TechCrunch confirm the planned dinner meeting after the missed state dinner. TechCrunch adds the detail of it being the first one-on-one encounter. Still uncertain: No further details on timing, agenda, or outcomes are provided in the sources.
body.zh-TW: 導言：Anthropic 執行長達里奧·阿莫代（Dario Amodei） 缺席國宴後，預計將與川普總統共進晚餐。 事件經過：根據 CNBC 報導，當多位科技執行長出席川普總統為中國國家主席習近平舉辦的華麗晚宴時，Anthropic 執行長明顯缺席。TechCrunch 則指出，這場即將舉行的晚餐將是達里奧·阿莫代（Dario Amodei） 與唐納·川普（Donald Trump）的首次一對一會面。 重要性：此會面發生在阿莫代缺席涉及多位科技領袖與中國國家主席的高規格活動之後，凸顯 Anthropic 領導層與美國政府的另行接觸。 來源一致與分歧：CNBC 與 TechCrunch 均確認缺席國宴後的晚餐計畫，TechCrunch 補充這是首次一對一會面。 仍未確定：來源未提供時間、議程或結果等進一步細節。

title.en: RAF Fairford Air Base: Five Arrested on Suspicion of Terrorism in UK
title.zh-TW: 皇家空軍費爾福德空軍基地（RAF Fairford）：英國五人因恐怖主義嫌疑被捕

summary.en: UK police arrested five men near RAF Fairford air base on suspicion of preparing a terrorist act after three suspicious vehicles were spotted. The base has been used by US forces. Homes were evacuated and explosives offenses are under investigation by counter-terrorism police.
summary.zh-TW: 英國警方在皇家空軍費爾福德空軍基地（RAF Fairford）附近逮捕五名男子，涉嫌準備恐怖行為。三輛可疑車輛被發現，該基地曾供美軍使用。反恐警察調查爆炸物罪行，並疏散附近住戶。

body.en: Lede: Five men were arrested by British counterterrorism police near RAF Fairford air base in the UK on suspicion of preparing a terrorist act. What happened: Three suspicious vehicles were reported traveling toward the base early Sunday. Police evacuated nearby homes after spotting the vehicles. The men were detained following reports of hooded and balaclavaed individuals near white vans in Whelford. Why it matters: RAF Fairford has served as a launch point for US military operations. The incident prompted a major counter-terrorism response. Sources agree/disagree: All sources confirm five arrests, three vehicles, and suspicion of a terrorist act near the base. title.en: Hong Jianhua, Known as Replica of Takeshi Kaneshiro, Dies at 49 After Decade-Long Cancer Fight
title.zh-TW: 洪楗華（Hong Jianhua）「翻版金城武」抗癌10年病逝享年49歲

summary.en: Hong Kong singer Hong Jianhua, nicknamed the replica of Takeshi Kaneshiro, passed away at age 49 following a 10-year battle with cancer. His condition had recently improved, but friends expressed shock that their last conversation became a permanent farewell. He was known for the song '我失戀你悲傷'. Multiple Taiwanese entertainment outlets reported the news.
summary.zh-TW: 香港歌手洪楗華（Hong Jianhua）被稱為「翻版金城武」，在抗癌10年後於49歲病逝。病情一度好轉，但好友驚訝最後對話竟成永別。他以歌曲《我失戀你悲傷》聞名。多個台灣娛樂媒體報導此消息。

body.en: Lede: Hong Jianhua, the Hong Kong singer known as the replica of Takeshi Kaneshiro, has died at 49 after fighting cancer for 10 years. What happened: Sources report that Hong Jianhua's condition had shown improvement recently, yet he passed away. Friends were saddened, with one noting they did not expect the last conversation to be a farewell. He gained recognition for singing '我失戀你悲傷'. Why it matters: The news highlights the challenges faced by entertainers in the East Asian entertainment industry battling long-term illnesses, drawing attention from Taiwanese media outlets. Sources agree/disagree: All reports from outlets including 噓！星聞, Yahoo新聞, UDN, 東森電視, 鏡報, and news.tvbs.com.tw align on the age, duration of illness, recent improvement, and friends' reactions. Still uncertain: No further details on the exact date of death or specific medical updates beyond the reported improvement are provided in the sources.
body.zh-TW: 導言：香港歌手洪楗華（Hong Jianhua）被稱為「翻版金城武」，在抗癌10年後於49歲病逝。 事件經過：消息指出洪楗華病情一度好轉，卻仍告辭世。好友感到悲痛，有人提到沒想到最後對話竟成永別。他因演唱《我失戀你悲傷》而知名。 重要性：此消息凸顯東亞娛樂圈藝人長期抗病挑戰，吸引台灣媒體關注。 來源一致與分歧：噓！星聞、Yahoo新聞、UDN、東森電視、鏡報及news.tvbs.com.tw等媒體報導在年齡、病程、近期好轉及好友反應上均一致。 仍未確定：來源未提供確切逝世日期或超出已報導好轉的醫療細節。
